description: Loads a public landing page in a real browser (desktop and mobile), and returns a conversion score from 0 to 100, seven sub-scores (clarity, value proposition, CTA, trust, design, mobile, SEO basics), the top 3 issues with concrete fixes, what already works, a short AI-readiness score, and fix_prompt: a Markdown prompt that hands the fixes to a coding agent such as Claude Code or Cursor. Use it when someone wants feedback on why a homepage, landing page or pricing page does not convert, wants a second opinion before a launch, or wants to compare their page with a competitor's. Do not use it for pages behind a login, for non-HTML files, or for general SEO keyword research. It takes 30 to 90 seconds; if it returns status "running", call get_audit_result with the audit_id. The free result is complete on its own. The full report (every other issue ranked by the points it costs, the 36-check list, 3 headline and 3 CTA rewrites, 5 quick wins, mobile review, full AI-readiness fixes) costs $5 USD one-time, paid by a human at report_url. Set language to "pt" for a report in Brazilian Portuguese. A URL audited through the API in the last 24 hours (in the same language) returns that same result. Limit: 5 new audits per hour per client, 20 with an API key. With an API key that has credits (Authorization: Bearer header; 10 full reports for $29, see https://pagecritic.app/developers), the result includes the full report.

language.description: Language of the report: "en" (English, default), "pt" (Brazilian Portuguese), "es" (Latin American Spanish). Headline and CTA rewrites stay in the page's own language. Prices stay in USD.

url.description: Full URL of the public web page, e.g. https://example.com or https://example.com/pricing.
